anchor.snippet: export function shellEnvironment(overrides = {}, { inherited = process.env, platform = process.platform, userDirectory = homedir() } = {}) {

entries.note: Spreading process.env loses Windows' case-insensitive lookup behavior. Normalize inherited and override names before adding CLI directories so a new PATH cannot mask the real Path. Later overrides retain their spelling, POSIX keys remain case-sensitive, and Electron's run-as-Node setting is removed regardless of Windows casing. Explicit inputs make the platform transformation testable on Mac without claiming Windows process qualification.

The sidecar owns PTYs independently of display connections. Socket detach must never invoke stop or shutdown. Exited state comes from the actual PTY exit event; layout/session records cannot resurrect a PID.

Stop targets descendants from a fresh numeric process-tree snapshot, then the owned root. Windows uses taskkill /T. POSIX escalates after a grace period only while the tracked PTY remains alive. Adversarial detached descendants and PID-reuse edge cases still need qualification; do not claim this is a security sandbox.
